title: Centered Star Pyramid Pattern
statement: Input a positive integer N and print a centered star pyramid using nested loops. Requirements: Use an outer loop for rows and inner loops for leading spaces and stars. The first row has 1 star, each subsequent row increases by 2 stars, the pyramid is centered, and the last row contains 2N - 1 stars.
hints: Carefully review the requirements in FAST_CL1002_F26_LAB10_P3.
Use standard C++ PF-lab constructs (nested loops, basic arrays, no banned STL).

title: Square Border & Diagonals Pattern
statement: Input an integer N (>= 3) and print an N x N square pattern using nested loops. Requirements: Outer loop for rows, inner loop for columns, print '*' on the border or either diagonal and a space elsewhere, output N characters per row with a newline after each row, and display an error message if N < 3.
hints: Carefully review the requirements in FAST_CL1002_F26_LAB10_P4.
Use standard C++ PF-lab constructs (nested loops, basic arrays, no banned STL).
